title: Figaro Clause Spec (Layer A)
description: The canonical shape of a Figaro clause specification — the off-chain JSON a clause author writes, pins to IPFS, and registers in ClauseRegistry. This schema is the published mirror of the reference parser `parseClauseSpec` (sdk/src/clauses/spec.ts); a conformance test (sdk/tests/clauses/schema-conformance.test.ts) keeps the two in lockstep. Validate your clause against this before registering it — a clause that does not conform is not surfaced by conforming frontends (resolved-empty = absence, never an error). The schema is OPEN (additionalProperties allowed): unknown fields are tolerated and ignored, so the format can grow by versioning without rejecting older clauses.

clauseId.description: Human-readable clause name. keccak256(abi.encode(clauseId, version)) is the on-chain bytes32 id.

categories.description: Open discovery taxonomy (e.g. "geo", "emissions", "lifecycle"). categories[0] is the substrate class: family = keccak256(categories[0]) on-chain, which the RPGF substrate-broadening formula weights. NOT a grouping word (that is block.article).

fields.description: The clause's content fields. The default shape, applied to all stages unless a stage override is set.

stages.description: Optional per-stage field overrides, keyed by stage number (uint8 0..255).

label.description: Cosmetic display label (Layer-A only; validator + prover ignore it).

default.description: Build/UI default (composition metadata; the ABI encoder ignores it). Shape must match the field type.

values.description: enum only — the ordered value codes.

sentinel.description: enum only — an ABI position-as-index placeholder, never a valid input.

items.description: array only — the element field spec (its name/required are injected, so omit them).

fields.description: object only — the nested (named) field specs.

field.description: A named field — top-level, stage-override, or object property. Requires name + type + required.

itemField.description: An array ELEMENT spec. The parser injects name + required, so only type is required here.

block.description: Block-binding metadata: how a clause composes into the UI + runtime. The on-chain validator and Rust prover IGNORE this entire object — it is Layer-A-only.

tier.description: How the clause's content in the signed agreement relates to its runtime attestation. cross-checked: committed in the agreement, runtime attestation verified byte-identical. runtime: content produced/attested live. agreement-only: in the agreement, no validator (e.g. topology).

article.description: Drawer grouping heading (free-form, never a closed list). The contract-document SECTION this clause reads under. Distinct from the substrate class (categories/family).

mechanismKinds.description: OPTIONAL. Mechanism kinds an assembly includes when this clause is anchored. Omit (absent => []) for a clause that wires no mechanism module.

moduleIds.description: OPTIONAL. Runtime view-tier modules that consume/produce this clause's data. Omit (absent => []) when route-tier only or none.

routes.description: Route-tier surfaces that show this clause.

sisterClauseId.description: A runtime-attestation companion clause emitted as an empty anchor.

nestsUnder.description: A field name on a parent clause this clause nests under in the drawer.

structural.description: Composed on EVERY order (not a designer choice) — e.g. commerce, topology.

defaultOn.description: Pre-composed on every fresh designer node; removable in the drawer.

handoffStages.description: Ladder stage codes that are physical hand-offs (value changes hands).
